title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Latest RemoteOK inventory validated for target-family scope and Canadian regional eligibility. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
latest_update: Latest update: October 9, 2026 — RemoteOK API (HTTP 200, 99 jobs) fully reviewed: nothing in the DevOps/SRE/Platform family is open to Canada. The latest-100 inventory is mostly sales, HR, annotation and software roles.

notes_sections.heading: October 9 inventory audit
items: Endpoint https://remoteok.com/api → HTTP 200, JSON, 100 objects (1 metadata + 99 jobs), dated 2026-07-30 to 2026-10-07. Per-family match counts: DevOps 0 · Senior DevOps 0 · SRE 0 · Platform 1 (RedMimicry, Germany) · Cloud 0 · DevSecOps 0 · Infrastructure 1 (Arango, Go software) · adjacent 3 (Mirantis, AWeber, KPI Solutions).
API descriptions are truncated to ~300 characters; canonical pages show only a summary behind the apply wall, so Arango/Mirantis are classified on title and visible summary only.
Pay was excluded from scoring at Marc's request.

notes_sections.heading: October 5 full-read pass
items: Scored every one of the 99 postings’ description text (not the title) for DevOps, SRE, reliability, CI/CD, infrastructure, Kubernetes, Terraform, observability and deployment mentions. The top scorers were Evolve Staff Software Engineer (13; Remote – US only), Delinea Staff SDE SDM (9; Redwood City), a Java developer (8) and a Boston MTS role (7); only KPI Solutions’ Software Deployment Engineer (5) is a deployment role, and it is the warehouse-automation hardware position already recorded as out of scope. No posting mentions Canada eligibility alongside meaningful infrastructure work. The API’s ~100-item window still shows no turnover in target-family postings since 2026-09-19.

notes_sections.heading: October 5 run
items: Direct curl of remoteok.com/api returned HTTP 200 with 99 job objects; inventory has not turned over (newest relevant posting dated 2026-09-19). KPI Solutions remains out of scope (warehouse-automation role), Arango remains unvalidated (Premium-gated requirements), Tessera Labs is an Oracle Fusion ERP lead (out of scope). Fourth consecutive run with zero target-family turnover.

notes_sections.heading: Could not validate
items: Golang Kubernetes Engineer — Arango (posted September 16, plausible Platform-family fit): the API description is still truncated to marketing boilerplate and an anti-spam instruction with no real requirements; re-checked the canonical detail page directly via HTTP this run — it still gates salary and full requirements behind a Premium unlock. Not scored per the validation rule — a snippet is not sufficient. View posting. (Repeat unresolved case from the 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-21 runs — still incomplete in the current inventory window.)

notes_sections.heading: Search limitations
items: The public API returned 99 job objects (direct HTTP access worked cleanly this run, no 403 or block encountered); 24 were dated within the preferred 14-day window (since 2026-09-08).
The API is a latest-inventory feed, not a dedicated keyword-search endpoint — the full returned inventory was reviewed for target titles, tags, and description signals.

The same three bare-'devops'/'cloud'-tagged generalist postings from the prior run resurfaced (DESARROLLADOR FULL STACK — Kruger NearShore/Rekluti; Staff Software Development Engineer SDM — Delinea; Staff Software Engineer — Evolve) but their titles and full tag sets read as generalist full-stack/identity-platform/software-engineering roles, not DevOps/Platform/SRE center of gravity — screened out by title and tag review, not opened in full.
No eligible, unclear, or known-pipeline target-family role surfaced this run. No CAPTCHA, verification page, or write-side action occurred.

Several RemoteOK postings scored in the 2026-08-25 run (Akuity, DoiT, Lemon.io, Livepeer, Shakepay — all Skipped in applications.md as of 2026-09-19) remain off the API's ~100-item latest-inventory window and were not part of today's inventory.

Inventory has been effectively static for three consecutive runs (2026-09-19, 2026-09-21, 2026-09-22) — the same Harper/KPI Solutions/Arango trio is the entire plausible candidate pool each time, with zero turnover. Worth checking less frequently than daily until the API window rolls over further.

rows.title: Engineering Manager, TLM Platform
rows.location: San Francisco — “Based in SF or willing to relocate,” fully on-site, no remote option
rows.gap: Real substance — owns infrastructure, developer productivity, and SRE/production support, with hands-on AWS/GCP, Kubernetes, and Docker requirements — but on-site San Francisco with no remote option is outside the reachable-city range (Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, Cornwall, Montréal), a hard geography gate on its own. Separately it's a formal Engineering Manager role (flexible on tenure but still people-management scope), a different shape than Marc's ‘leads without authority’ positioning. Reviewed in full via the canonical detail page. Repeat posting, unchanged since the 2026-09-18/09-19/09-21 runs, still live.

rows.title: Software Deployment Engineer
rows.location: Cincinnati, OH (on-site delivery, plus remote/office phases)
rows.gap: Despite the ‘Deployment Engineer’ title, the actual work is warehouse-automation hardware/software commissioning — pick-to-light systems, overhead illuminators, AutoStore/T-sort integration, on-site installation and IQ/UAT sign-off for a supply-chain systems integrator. Not a software CI/CD or infrastructure deployment role; no cloud, IaC, or platform-engineering component. Reviewed in full, unchanged since the 2026-09-21 run.
